theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_cz_top_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid n)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn V n), 0 < n → IsOpen V → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → ∃ g : Euclid n → ℤ, LocallyIntegrableOn (fun y => (g y : ℝ)) V volume ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, X ω = ∫ y, (g y : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) y ⇑(EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ)
